note: Digest-pinned evidence index for req/phase8-2-benchmark.md: identifies the raw trees, their pre-normalization digests, the path normalization applied to the committed copies, the slim-session derivation, and every measured input, source commit and environment. committed_files pins the SHA-256 of every committed raw file; git additionally pins the committed bytes.

layout.raw_wp3: raw/wp3/<manifest-relative path> (458 files; 33 sessions/*/session.json slimmed per slim_session_rule)
layout.raw_wp4: raw/wp4/<manifest-relative path> (181 files, unmodified except normalization)

wp3.description: WP3 headline text baseline (controlled and stock adapters, FFM diagnostics): sessions pilot, qual x2, A, A2, A3, B, B2, B3, diag-5-1
wp3.scratch_root: ../../wp3-scratch (the local scratch directory, sibling of the repository, where the sessions were generated; the normalized committed copies live at raw/wp3 and are digest-pinned in committed_files - the local directory is not the archive)

code.note: verified dirty:false in every session.json code block

java.flags: recorded per worker in each report identity

workload_manifest.note: pins every checkpoint file (repository, revision, per-file sha256 and bytes, license), the frozen prompts with sha256, the run policy and the worker source digests; its sha256 equals the workers' identity manifest_sha256

ffm_calibration_record.source: findings section 15.4 local measurement baseline (the build/ffm-cal/ artifact of the measurement-time run is not archived)
ffm_calibration_record.workload: 5 forks x 200 iterations x 2000 calls, warmup 2000, n = 1000 pooled samples per shape
ffm_calibration_record.limitation: the measurement-time run's per-shape p10/p90 are not recorded, so the calibration ranges of the published FFM estimates (findings 16.6) are not bit-reproducible; the per-call medians are recorded to 2 decimal places (ns/call) except the four struct-return shapes (52.2/54.1/54.1/55.1, recorded to 1 decimal in findings 15.4), so the published per-decode-step / prefill / request-total budget medians are reproducible from this record only within the per-call recording bound (0.05 ns/call for those four shapes, 0.005 ns/call for the rest, times the budget's per-request call count) plus the published value's own display rounding (0.005 us for the 2-decimal-us figures, 0.0005 ms for the 3-decimal-ms figure) - the bound Phase82SummaryVerifierTest applies. The per-shape p10/p90 ranges recorded beside them in findings 16.6 cannot be recomputed at all

wp4.description: WP4 both-pin, both-VLM first inference: full sessions wp4-observed-cache-1/-2 (24 workers each) and the 1-pair local smoke wp4-smoke (4 workers)
wp4.scratch_root: ../../wp4-scratch (the local scratch directory, sibling of the repository, where the sessions were generated; the normalized committed copies live at raw/wp4 and are digest-pinned in committed_files - the local directory is not the archive)

old_tree.note: worktree outside the checkout, pinned old native runtime (findings 17.1)

new_tree.note: the branch tree of PR #92; per-session measured commits are recorded in findings 17.1/17.3/17.6 and in the executed-jar digests of the schema -2 session-report tree blocks

ci_smoke.note: the original Actions artifact zip of run 43307319179; sha256 equals the recorded GitHub artifact digest (manifest ci_smoke.artifact)

normalization.description: every absolute local path in the committed copies is rewritten to its form relative to the repository directory; no local username appears in the committed raw tree
normalization.invariant: zero occurrences of the local username path prefix in every committed raw file (checked at copy time; re-checked by the raw-to-summary verifier)
normalization.retained: /Users/ghrunner/* in raw/wp3/hostrec/a3-block/rsswatch.log (103 process-table lines naming the self-hosted Actions runner's own binary); that prefix is already public on origin/main (tools/qwen35-reference/evidence/), and it is a process path, not a local file reference

slim_session_rule: raw/wp3/sessions/*/session.json is the original record with each workers[] entry's requests array replaced by {n_requests, report, report_sha256}: report is the repository-relative path of the committed full worker report, and report_sha256 is that report's pre-normalization digest from the wp3 manifest. The full worker reports are committed unmodified except path normalization, so nothing measured is lost: the session metadata and summary block are byte-for-byte the original values, and every worker's requests are in the referenced report.
